name: domain-mapping
description: Discover business domains through EventStorming, evidence, recursive questions, and conformance checks.

interface.shortDescription: Map behavior, verify evidence, and improve the method.
interface.longDescription: Collaborative EventStorming with a portable domain model, missing-question checks, evidence drift detection, recorded conformance results, and regression-based workflow improvement.

Audit this domain map and explain the next experiments.
